title: Tom's Toys
text:
Tom has a red ball. He plays with it in the park every day. He also has a blue kite. His sister, Ana, likes card games.

On Sunday, Tom and Ana play a board game at home. Ana wins the game. Tom is sad for a minute, but then they laugh together. After the game, they eat cake.

questions.text: What game do Tom and Ana play on Sunday?
Why is Tom sad for a minute?
How do Tom and Ana probably feel after the game?

vocabulary.definition: a public place with grass and trees where people can play and walk
a toy that flies in the air at the end of a string
is the best player and finishes first in a game
to make sounds with your voice because something is funny

paragraph_translations: Tom tiene una pelota roja. Juega con ella en el parque todos los días. También tiene una cometa azul. Su hermana, Ana, le gustan los juegos de cartas.
El domingo, Tom y Ana juegan a un juego de mesa en casa. Ana gana el juego. Tom está triste por un minuto, pero luego se ríen juntos. Después del juego, comen pastel.
